## Acceptance criteria
1. With `max_runs=2` and two tickets with disjoint fences, `./dev.py test tests/unit/test_parallel_dispatch.py` shows both in `admission.running` at once. It rules out the second waiting for the first.
2. With `max_runs=1`, a second dispatch waits while one run is in `running`. `./dev.py test tests/unit/test_parallel_dispatch.py` rules out two concurrent runs.
3. With one ticket in `running`, `Scheduler.dispatch_next` does not dispatch a candidate whose fence overlaps it. A candidate skipped `SKIP_LIMIT` times blocks a later non-overlapping one on the next call. With no free slot, `dispatch_next` returns `None` without dispatching. `./dev.py test tests/unit/test_parallel_dispatch.py` rules out dispatching past the barrier or beyond `max_runs`.
4. `waiting_for_merge` lends out only its own run's hold while the other run stays in `running`. `./dev.py test tests/unit/test_parallel_dispatch.py` rules out clearing the whole set.
5. `DaemonAdmission.occupied()` returns true while either of two runs is in `running` and while only a task is present, and false when both are empty. `./dev.py test tests/unit/test_parallel_dispatch.py` rules out reporting idle while one of two runs is active. `grep -n "occupied()" clutch/serve.py clutch/__main__.py` exits 0.
6. `Serve.upgrade_idle` on an `object.__new__(serve.Serve)` whose fake core has a non-empty `admission.running` returns `False`. `./dev.py test tests/unit/test_parallel_dispatch.py` rules out upgrading while a run is in flight.
7. `daemon_core(...)` with fake callables gives `admission.max_runs == 3` when `load()` returns `scheduler.parallel` enabled with `max_runs: 3`, and `1` when it is disabled. `./dev.py test tests/unit/test_parallel_dispatch.py` rules out parallel runs with the setting off.
8. The `serve_rig` dispatch-order tests pass with dispatch started as a task: `./dev.py test tests/unit/test_supervise_idle_hooks.py tests/unit/test_calibration_idle.py tests/unit/test_drain_serve_triage_idle.py` exits 0.
9. No `active`, `task` or `_slot` access on admission remains: `grep -rnE "admission\.(active|task\b|_slot)" clutch tests` exits 1 with no output.
10. The full suite passes with the updated assertions: `./dev.py test` exits 0.
